newsitem.title: INDIA: India gilt prices rise, rate cuts foreseen.
newsitem.headline: India gilt prices rise, rate cuts foreseen.

text.p: * Indian gilt prices continue to rise in afternoon trade on demand, undeterred by the political drama gripping the country, dealers say.
* Focus more on short and medium-term securities, buying interest in longer-term stocks on lower key, dealers say.
* Good liquidity with banks, expectations of falling interest rates after Reserve Bank of India announces credit and monetary policy on April 15 seen fuelling demand.
* Parliament was debating a confidence motion for the minority government, vote is set for 8 p.m. (1430 GMT)
* In latest deals, 13.50 percent 1997 stock traded at 102.47 rupees from 102.45 in early trade, 13.62 percent 1998 at 105.05 from 104.90.
* The 13.80 2002 rises to 105.10 from 105 on Thursday, 11 percent 2002 to 95.04 from 94.62.
